$comment: The permission profile every Claude Eindri is launched with (plan 239 P5c). A worker runs unattended in its own Yggdrasil worktree, so it may edit and run commands without a prompt (the same latitude opencode workers get from OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT permission *:allow), while the moves that only the Allfather makes, or that destroy unrecorded work, are denied. Deny rules win over allow rules.
